story: IDS confirmation — CIC-IoT-2023 subsample: B15-AC (and co-leader B05-AC) vs Wc-CTRL on held-out FPR
registered_by: Luiz: 'queue the CIC-IoT confirmation with B05-AC too'; design from the experiment-design agent's IDS-2 power analysis (26/09)
cohort: IDSXD3-ciciot-quad-96b-{B15-AC,B05-AC,Wc-CTRL}-r{20408..20413}: byte-identical clones of the IDSXD2 r20406 flows, only `seed` changed; SEED-MAJOR interleaved; 18 flows
never_pool: The screening seeds 20403-20407 (IDSXD/IDSXD2) are NOT pooled into this test.
metric: held-out TEST val_cal, GA-neurons phase, genome_type best_f1 (validation_summaries final rows) — the cell the screening flagged
primary: B15-AC minus Wc-CTRL on FPR, paired by seed. CONFIRMED iff Holm-adjusted two-sided paired-t p < 0.05 AND >= 5 of 6 seeds favour B15-AC.
secondary: B05-AC minus Wc-CTRL on FPR, same test; Holm across the 2 contrasts.
descriptive_only: F1 deltas (not powered: the screening F1 gap needs n=10-16); B15-AC vs B05-AC head-to-head; generations run per arm (a mediator under the IDSZ 24/08 ruling, disclosed not penalised).
decision: If primary confirms: B15-AC is the IDS-5 (CIC-IoT n=100) config with 'lower FPR, confirmed; F1 indistinguishable'. If it fails: keep Wc-CTRL (production control) per the IDS-2 tie-break (equal F1 -> lower FPR -> fewer generations). If only the secondary confirms: B05-AC, same wording.
era_note: Flies on worker ABI 14 (WNN-1 counter-RNG): unlike the screening runs, each flow is reproducible from its seed.
apply_with: scripts/ids2/ (reuse load.py/anal.py pairing), restricted to IDSXD3 + fresh seeds

override.by: Luiz: 'adopt B05-AC for IDS-5, record it as an override'
override.decision: IDS-5 (CIC-IoT n=100) takes B05-AC instead of the rule's default Wc-CTRL.
override.basis: A config DECISION, not a claim: direction and consistency — FPR -1.51 pp 5/6 seeds (replicating the IDS-2 screen), F1 +0.26 pp 6/6, Acc +0.10 pp 6/6; B05-AC has the tighter FPR spread (0.63 vs 0.90 for B15-AC).
override.not_claimed: The FPR reduction is NOT reported as significant (Holm p=0.109). The best_fpr-genome pass (p=0.013) was not pre-registered and is not evidence.
